Calculate the number-average molecular weight M_n of the polymer sample.
Use the molecular weights and counts: 56526 g/mol with 96 chains, 92809 g/mol with 131 chains, 115856 g/mol with 153 chains, and 126029 g/mol with 146 chains.
Compute M_n as the sum of each molecular weight multiplied by its count, divided by the sum of the counts.
The result is 102111.6 g/mol, which rounds to 102112 g/mol.
